Build a dataset's bundle tables in a DuckDB connection

Source: R/bundle.R
bundle_build_tables.Rd

For each table bundle_plan() includes, one table {prefix}{table} in con: the dataset's rows cut by the plan's rule, geometry and H3 cell columns dropped (latitude and longitude stay), and readable columns added beside keys so a row reads without a join:

Usage

bundle_build_tables(con, plan, dataset_key, from_sql, prefix = "bundle_")

Arguments

con

a DuckDB connection

plan

the data frame from bundle_plan()

dataset_key

the dataset

from_sql

named character, table -> a FROM expression for the release table (read_parquet('…'), or a parenthesised view such as the catalog's obs)

prefix

name prefix of the tables written

Value

A data frame, one row per table written (presentation order): table, rows, n_columns, dropped (comma-separated columns left out), added (comma-separated columns added). A companion table with no rows is dropped and not listed.

Details

  • beside sample_key: site_key, line, station (from sample; line and station parsed from a site_key of the form 090.0 060.0, empty otherwise);

  • beside site_key on sample itself: line, station;

  • beside taxon_key: scientific_name, common_name (from taxon);

  • beside measurement_type: units (from measurement_type).

A column is only added to a table that does not already carry one by that name, and never to the table it comes from. Rows are stored under ORDER BY ALL, so a table's order is a function of its content (the zips are hashed). Intermediate tables are dropped.

See also

bundle_plan(), write_bundle()
